case.summary: Alert HHF-008 was triggered on card C07871-K1 by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.81 on transaction 3660353 for $165.65. The bank's calibrated second-generation model scored the transaction at only 0.008 with a 0.63% historical fraud rate, and the purchase aligned with the cardholder's established history of in-person product W transactions. Additionally, this transaction was the third consecutive daily in-person purchase in region 87 with non-escalating amounts, demonstrating legitimate travel under bank policy. The card has no links to active fraud rings or shared syndicates, and similar travel-related alerts on this card were previously cleared. The transaction is determined to be legitimate cardholder activity.
